verdict.rationale: Firebase's own CLI documents importing and exporting users from Firebase Auth, and a community user says they treat Firebase Database as a JSON store they can export to another NoSQL service. That covers only slices of an exit path. Community reports also say storage rules must be reimplemented after switching away, so not everything is portable. missing for 10: documented full-project export covering Firestore, Realtime Database, Cloud Storage and config, confirmation that exports use open formats (the Auth export format is unstated), and first-party migration/exit documentation.
